results.Description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires a single-pointer alternative for author-controlled drag operations
results.Do: Add buttons menus or tap-to-move controls and retain keyboard operation
results.Don't: Make dragging the only way to reorder resize or select
results.Code Example Good: Move up and Move down buttons beside drag handle

project_review.accepted: Dragging requires a usable point/click or keyboard alternative
project_review.status: Existing relative-position dropdown already reuses core and has GUI regression coverage;retain it in the modern workspace and separately verify keyboard usability. Concept tool does not implement production dragging.
